title: Cloud Warehouses vs Lakehouses: One Key Idea

scenes.line1: Why are modern data platforms so flexible?
scenes.say: Why are cloud warehouses and lakehouses so flexible and cost-effective? What’s the secret behind their design?

scenes.label: Separation
scenes.sub: Storage and compute are decoupled for scaling.
scenes.say: The key is separation of storage and compute. Data sits in storage, while compute clusters process queries independently.
Snowflake uses virtual warehouses for compute. BigQuery uses slots. Both let you scale up or down without touching your stored data.
You can pause compute to save money, resize clusters for your workload, and optimize queries to reduce scanned data.

scenes.question: Does scaling storage affect compute?
scenes.right: No, storage and compute scale independently.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Does scaling storage affect compute? No, storage and compute scale independently. That’s the big advantage.
